changelog:
✅ 响应压缩上线:网关层 gzip 透明压缩(替代旧 docker/caddy 拓扑里 Caddy encode 的职责——新版部署直接裸端口,前面没有反代了)。客户端带 Accept-Encoding: gzip 即生效,SSE 逐事件 flush 保持实时不缓冲;HEAD / Range / 204/304 / gzip;q=0 不压。目标是 kirogo 与前置网关(NewAPI 独立主机)之间这段有限带宽。Go 系客户端(NewAPI)透明解压,行为无感。
✅ download 地址切换到本 fork(SunNorthGod/Kiro-Go):上游 Quorinex/Kiro-Go 自 2026-02-23 起停更,本项目此后独立维护。

---

✅ 503 "No available accounts" 的真正原因已定位并修掉：不是账号不够，也不是冷却，而是**客户端请求了一个账号列表里没有的模型名**。上线诊断日志后第一条就报出来了：`model="simple-task" pooled=10 noModel=10 cooling=0 nearTokenExpiry=0 quotaBlocked=0`——十个账号全被「不支持该模型」这一条过滤掉，其余五个过滤条件全为 0。而这个模型其实是能用的：历史上 12 次 simple-task 请求在「重启后模型缓存尚冷、过滤器乐观放行」的窗口里发到上游，12 次全部成功。也就是说上游服务这个模型，只是 ListAvailableModels 没有把它列出来，我们却据此硬拦，并把结果报告成「容量不足」。现在：模型过滤只是路由建议，当它会导致「一个账号都选不出」时就放行，交给上游裁决——真不存在的模型会拿到上游自己的 400（说了实话），而不是一个把方向指错的 503。
✅ 未知模型名的 400 不再跨账号级联：既然这类请求现在会发到上游，上游回的 "Invalid model" / "This model doesn't support..." 必须一次终止，否则会在每个账号上重试一遍并顺手冷却它们（此前 24 小时内 8 次 Invalid model + 25 次 This model doesn't support 全部记在账号头上）。已归入「请求本身有问题」一类，不惩罚账号。
✅ 客户端主动断开（Ctrl-C、关页面、取消）不再算作账号故障。这是生产里数量最大的一类错误——24 小时 458 次，超过任何真正的上游问题。此前只有 Claude 流式这一条路径做了判断，另外十处（Claude 非流式、两条 OpenAI 路径、responses API）都会把「客户端走了」记成服务该请求的账号出错。请求超时（DeadlineExceeded）仍按故障计。
✅ 503 现在会说明原因。能导致「选不出账号」的过滤条件有六个（卡密绑定、本次已重试、模型不支持、冷却中、令牌接近过期、额度超限），各自修法完全不同却都返回同一个 503；这类请求还根本不写 request_logs（写日志需要 account_id，而此时尚未选号），此前只能从外部反推。现在六项计数每次都打印，按 2 秒合并防止突发淹没信息。
✅ 上游过载（MODEL_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE / high load / AWS 500）不再惩罚账号，且全部端点都过载时退避重试整个端点周期（2 次，1.2s / 2.4s）。10 小时内上游回了 263 次「请稍后重试」，此前一次都没重试。
✅ 请求体收敛管线补上图片与工具结果：此前只截断文本，图片（base64）与结构化 tool_result 完全碰不到，「收敛完成」的请求仍有 2.9–6.1 MB（上限 900 KB），必然被上游 400 Input is too long 拒掉；更糟的是文本预算按整个请求体算，几 MB 附件会把预算压到 0，于是把客户端真正的指令磨到只剩 1 个字节、把保留的历史全换成占位符，只为给随后照旧发出的图片腾地方。现在按价值从低到高回收：先压工具结果（每份至少留 2 KB，条目本身绝不删除），只有「压文本证明无解」时才丢图片，历史图片先于当前消息图片，每次丢弃都在文本里留一句说明。能靠压文本解决的请求，附件一张不动。
✅ Root cause of the 503 "No available accounts" responses found and fixed — and it was not capacity or cooldowns. Clients were asking for a model name that no account advertises. The first diagnostic line after shipping the instrumentation said it outright: model="simple-task", pooled=10, noModel=10, with cooling, nearTokenExpiry, quotaBlocked and the bindings all zero. All ten accounts were filtered out by the model list alone — and that model works: all 12 historical requests for it that reached the upstream (during the window after a restart when the model cache is cold and the filter passes optimistically) succeeded. The backend serves it; only ListAvailableModels omits it, and we were hard-blocking on that and reporting the result as exhausted capacity. The model list is now a routing hint: when honouring it would leave no account at all, the request is routed anyway and the upstream decides. A model that genuinely does not exist now returns the upstream's own 400, which tells the client something true, instead of a 503 that points at the wrong problem.
✅ Unknown-model 400s no longer cascade across accounts. Since such requests now reach the upstream, its "Invalid model" / "This model doesn't support..." reply has to terminate the request rather than be retried on every account, cooling each one on the way (8 and 25 occurrences respectively in 24h, all charged to accounts). They are now classified as request faults, and accounts are not penalised.
✅ Client-side cancellations are no longer treated as account faults — the largest error class in production at 458 in 24 hours. Only the Claude streaming path checked for it; the other ten call sites charged a customer pressing Ctrl-C to whichever account was serving. Request timeouts still count as faults.
✅ The 503 now explains itself: all six filters that can empty the pool are logged with counts on every occurrence, collapsed on a 2-second window.
✅ Upstream overload no longer penalises accounts, and the endpoint cycle is retried with a linear backoff when every endpoint reports it.
✅ The payload convergence pipeline now reclaims image and tool-result bytes, cheapest-first, so oversized requests converge instead of being rejected with 400 Input is too long — and a request that text-trimming can fix keeps all of its attachments.
✅ 已合并上游修复:重复内容不再从流中丢失(#138)、major-only 版本号(opus-5)按 1M 上下文归类(#140)、流死亡未产出即重试(#143)、stop reasons / tool calls / cancellation 正确读取(#145)、空流与截断流检测(#146)、原生 web_search(Kiro MCP)、auth 与 profile region 分离、Microsoft SSO、越南语 i18n。
